strips.title: Setting up a new smart speaker: in real life

panels.head: Unbox
panels.text: New speaker, new app, and a setup screen that asks about saving your voice.

panels.head: Choose what to keep
panels.text: Set the history to auto-delete, or not save, before the first command.

panels.head: Check the plan
panels.text: Alexa+ and Gemini Live cost money if you lack Prime or Premium. Know it before you buy.

panels.head: Mic off
panels.text: Press the mute switch when you want the room private, or buy the one with no mic.
